patterns.description: In the drop, the edit cuts every beat (0.52 s at 116 BPM); 18 of 19 shots follow it.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.49 -> 1.86 cuts per second (3.8x faster).
A rgb split effect lands right on the drop (4.29 s).
A zoom transition lands right on the drop (4.29 s).
Opens with on-screen text ("区CapCut") in the first second to hook viewers.
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 18 times (source groups A, B, C, D).
